top_signals.title: U.S. vows ‘economic D-Day’ as Iran threatens to halt all oil exports
top_signals.summary: Iran in turn vowed to shut down all oil exports from the Gulf "if the economic war continues."
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: India Rejects Settlement Bids by Adani-Linked Funds, ET Reports
top_signals.summary: India’s markets regulator rejected settlement applications from overseas funds with significant stakes in Adani Group companies after their proposed terms fell short of the regulator’s requirements, the Economic Times reported.

top_signals.title: Suzuki unveils electric minivehicle that has a 310-kilometer range
top_signals.summary: Suzuki has yet to set a price for the model, due to come out this fiscal year, but aims to make it affordable enough to encourage a shift among gasoline car owners.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
